title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity
task: Multi-modal audio-video generation
key_results: Supports 4-15s video generation at 480p/720p; accepts 3 video clips, 9 images, 3 audio clips as reference; performance on par with leading models
comments: Industrial release demonstrates practical scalability of multi-modal generation, though quantitative comparisons with competitors are not provided.

title: RationalRewards: Reasoning Rewards Scale Visual Generation Both Training and Test Time
task: Improving visual generation via structured reward reasoning
key_results: RationalRewards (8B) achieves state-of-the-art preference prediction with 10-20x less training data; test-time critique-and-refine matches RL fine-tuning; improves text-to-image and image-editing generators
comments: Clever use of multi-dimensional rationales as optimization signals; PARROT framework avoids expensive rationale annotation through distillation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured rationales improve both training (as RL rewards) and test time (via prompt revision)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Generate-Critique-Refine loop matches RL-based fine-tuning on several benchmarks

title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents
task: Standardized, verifiable evaluation of multimodal game agents
key_results: GameWorld with 34 games and 170 tasks reveals frontier agents far from human capabilities; semantic action parsing outperforms computer-use agents
comments: State-verifiable metrics and semantic action space are valuable design choices, but limited to browser games and generalization to real-world embodied control unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic action parsing enables more reliable game agent evaluation than computer-use agents
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via superior performance on GameWorld tasks

title: SpatialEvo: Self-Evolving Spatial Intelligence via Deterministic Geometric Environments
task: 3D spatial reasoning via self-evolving framework
key_results: Highest average score at 3B and 7B scales across nine benchmarks; consistent gains on spatial reasoning with no degradation on general visual understanding
comments: Deterministic Geometric Environment is elegant: exploits that 3D ground truth is computable from geometry without model consensus, avoiding self-reinforcement of errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic geometric validation enables self-evolution without model consensus bias
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DGE constraints and task-adaptive scheduling achieve state-of-the-art performance

title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language World Models
task: Evaluating AI agents on professional occupational tasks
key_results: Benchmark covers 100 scenarios across 10 industries and 65 domains; implicit faults harder than explicit errors; GPT-5.2 gains 27.5 points with higher reasoning effort
comments: Language World Models enable cheap, scalable domain simulation; reveals that no model dominates all industries and that environmental robustness is often overlooked.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Implicit faults (data degradation) are harder to handle than explicit errors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: implicit faults lack overt error signals, requiring independent detection

title: Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents
task: Cross-domain memory transfer for coding agents
key_results: Cross-domain memory improves average performance by 3.7%; transfer effectiveness scales with memory pool size; high-level insights transfer better than low-level traces
comments: Meta-knowledge (validation routines) transfers across domains while task-specific code causes negative transfer—nuanced insight on abstraction level's role in transferability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Abstraction level dictates cross-domain memory transferability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: high-level insights generalize; low-level traces induce negative transfer

title: From P(y|x) to P(y): Investigating Reinforcement Learning in Pre-train Space
task: Reinforcement learning in pre-train space to enhance reasoning
key_results: NSR-PreRL increases transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x; DSRL outperforms strong baselines; negative sample reinforcement is highly effective driver
comments: Key insight that optimizing P(y) rather than P(y|x) bypasses base model limitations; mechanism of NSR (pruning incorrect reasoning) is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong gradient alignment exists between log P(y) and log P(y|x), making PreRL viable
hypotheses.result: Confirmed theoretically and empirically; NSR emerges as exceptionally effective mechanism

title: Target Policy Optimization
task: Policy gradient optimization via explicit target distribution
key_results: TPO matches or outperforms PG, PPO, GRPO, DG on easy tasks; substantially outperforms under sparse reward on billion-parameter LLM RLVR and tabular bandits
comments: Clever decoupling: separating target distribution construction from parameter updates allows cleaner optimization dynamics with loss gradient p^θ - q that vanishes at convergence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling target distribution and parameter updates improves optimization under sparse rewards
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TPO substantially outperforms standard policy-gradient methods on sparse reward tasks

title: SemaClaw: A Step Towards General-Purpose Personal AI Agents through Harness Engineering
task: General-purpose personal AI agents via harness engineering
key_results: Open-source multi-agent framework with DAG-based orchestration, PermissionBridge safety system, three-tier context management; supports persistent collaborative relationships
comments: Positions 'harness engineering' as primary differentiation as model capabilities converge; shifts focus from prompt engineering to infrastructure for reliability and auditability.

title: Free Geometry: Refining 3D Reconstruction from Longer Versions of Itself
task: Self-evolving 3D reconstruction at test time
key_results: Average improvement 3.73% in camera pose accuracy, 2.88% in point map prediction; <2 min LoRA update per dataset; improves Depth Anything 3 and VGGT without 3D ground truth
comments: Elegant self-supervision via view masking exploits that more views yield more reliable reconstructions; avoids need for expensive 3D annotation at test time.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-view feature consistency under frame masking enables test-time self-evolution without 3D ground truth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: consistent improvements across 4 benchmarks with lightweight LoRA updates

title: Sema Code: Decoupling AI Coding Agents into Programmable, Embeddable Infrastructure
task: Decoupling AI coding agent engine into embeddable infrastructure
key_results: Core engine as standalone npm library; powers VSCode extension and multi-channel messaging gateway (SemaClaw) from identical reasoning kernel; 8 key mechanisms for multi-tenant reliability
comments: Architectural contribution: separates reasoning engine from delivery form, enabling code reuse across heterogeneous developer environments.

title: TIP: Token Importance in On-Policy Distillation
task: Efficient on-policy knowledge distillation via token importance
key_results: Entropy-based sampling: 50% of tokens match all-token training, reduce peak memory by 47%; <10% of overconfident tokens nearly match full-token baselines; Q3-only <20% tokens surpass full OPD
comments: Two-axis taxonomy (entropy vs. teacher-student divergence) reveals overconfident tokens carry dense corrective signal despite being entropy-blind; explains why entropy alone is incomplete.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Overconfident (low-entropy, high-divergence) tokens carry more learning signal than entropy alone captures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: <10% overconfident tokens nearly match full-token training; two-axis selection rules more effective

title: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
task: Adaptive zoom-in for GUI element grounding
key_results: Gains of +13.4% on ScreenSpot-Pro, +10.3% on UI-Vision, +4.2% on ScreenSpot-v2; training-free; handles small icons and dense layouts
comments: Training-free uncertainty quantification approach; cleverly decomposes variance into spatial spread and box extent for per-instance crop radius.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uncertainty-driven crop sizing outperforms uniform zoom-in across instances
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: adaptive approach achieves significant gains without training

title: ReconPhys: Reconstruct Appearance and Physical Attributes from Single Video
task: 3D reconstruction with physical attribute estimation
key_results: 21.64 PSNR future prediction vs 13.27 optimization baseline; Chamfer Distance 0.004 vs 0.349; <1s inference vs hours; enables fast simulation-ready asset generation
comments: Novel feedforward + dual-branch architecture self-supervises physics without ground-truth labels; dramatic speedup enables practical robotics/graphics applications.

title: TREX: Automating LLM Fine-tuning via Agent-Driven Tree-based Exploration
task: Automating LLM fine-tuning via multi-agent tree-based exploration
key_results: Multi-agent system (Researcher + Executor) automates entire training lifecycle; FT-Bench benchmark with 10 real-world tasks demonstrates consistent performance optimization
comments: Treats iterative training as tree search with reusable results and insight distillation; addresses practical automation gap between isolated scientific tasks and complex workflows.

title: Exploration and Exploitation Errors Are Measurable for Language Model Agents
task: Quantifying exploration and exploitation errors in LM agents
key_results: Frontier LM agents struggle significantly; reasoning models solve more effectively; both errors improvable via minimal harness engineering
comments: Controllable grid/DAG environments enable policy-agnostic evaluation without internal access; reveals that stronger agents improve both through better tool use, not token consumption.

inputs: partially observable 2D grid, unknown task DAG

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reasoning models exhibit superior exploration-exploitation balance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: reasoning models solve tasks more effectively with improvable errors via harness engineering

title: MERRIN: A Benchmark for Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments
task: Evaluating search-augmented agents on multimodal evidence retrieval
key_results: Average accuracy 22.3% across agents; best agent 40.1%; Gemini Deep Research overexplores (more steps/tools) yet achieves modest gains; humans outperform agents with fewer resources
comments: Reveals critical gap between benchmark performance and real-world robustness; agents inefficient at source selection and over-rely on text despite multimodal tasks.

inputs: natural language query without modality cues

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stronger agents achieve higher accuracy but with diminishing returns due to distraction by conflicting web content
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: gains modest despite more steps/tools; reveals need for robust multimodal source selection

title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization
task: Long-horizon GUI automation with tool-integrated policy optimization
key_results: UI-Copilot-7B achieves SOTA on MemGUI-Bench; 17.1% absolute improvement on AndroidWorld over base Qwen; outperforms GUI-Owl-7B and UI-TARS-1.5-7B
comments: Memory decoupling + selective tool invocation (TIPO) elegantly addresses memory degradation and math hallucination; strong generalization to real-world tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating tool selection (single-turn) from task execution (multi-turn) improves long-horizon performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TIPO achieves SOTA via decoupled optimization; memory decoupling addresses context degradation

title: Do AI Coding Agents Log Like Humans? An Empirical Study
task: Empirical study of AI coding agent logging practices
key_results: Agents change logging less than humans (58.4% of repos); higher log density when they do; explicit instructions rare (4.7%) and ineffective (67% non-compliance); humans repair 72.5% of logs
comments: Reveals dual failure in natural language instruction for logging; agents as 'silent code generators' leaving observability debt for human 'janitors' to fix.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit natural language logging instructions effectively govern agent logging practices
hypotheses.result: Rejected: instructions rare and ineffective; agents fail to comply 67% of time

title: ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement
task: Segmenting novel and emerging entities via retrieval enhancement
key_results: ROSE outperforms Gemini-2.0 Flash baseline by 19.2 in gIoU on NEST benchmark; plug-and-play framework augments any MLLM-based segmentation model
comments: NEST task and benchmark address real problem: MLLMs struggle with novel/emerging entities; retrieval-augmented generation + visual/textual enhancement is practical solution.

title: InfiniteScienceGym: An Unbounded, Procedurally-Generated Benchmark for Scientific Analysis
task: Procedurally-generated benchmark for scientific analysis
key_results: None of 15+ evaluated models exceed 45% accuracy; recognizing unanswerable questions is major weakness; stronger models use tools more effectively
comments: Infinite procedural generation avoids publication bias and label noise; useful complement to static benchmarks for targeting blind spots without large data distribution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Procedurally-generated benchmarks reveal different failure modes than published-dataset benchmarks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: none exceed 45% accuracy; abstention and tool-mediated analysis major weaknesses

title: Mobile GUI Agents under Real-world Threats: Are We There Yet?
task: Evaluating mobile GUI agents under real-world adversarial threats
key_results: All agents significantly degraded by third-party content; misleading rates 42.0% (dynamic) and 36.1% (static); framework enables flexible, targeted app modifications
comments: Pre-deployment validation reveals critical gap: benchmark performance doesn't reflect robustness to realistic noisy app content; important for safe real-world deployment.

inputs: modified app UI with adversarial content

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mobile GUI agents maintain performance on real apps with untrustworthy third-party content
hypotheses.result: Rejected: significant degradation with 36-42% misleading rates under adversarial content

title: Atomistic characterization of the maturation mechanisms in the HIV-1 capsid domain
task: Characterize conformational transitions in HIV-1 capsid protein maturation
key_results: Immature CA monomer is intrinsically unstable and rapidly converts to mature form
Conformational change proceeds through stepwise ratcheting transitions with a metastable intermediate state identified
comments: Enhanced sampling simulations effectively bridge experimental structures (X-ray/cryo-EM) with dynamic mechanistic detail, though validation against kinetic experiments would strengthen claims about conversion rates.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Immature CA monomer is thermodynamically unstable relative to mature form
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via free energy calculations showing rapid spontaneous conversion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Maturation proceeds through direct two-state transition
hypotheses.result: Rejected; stepwise ratcheting mechanism with metastable intermediate identified

hypotheses.hypothesis: Charged interdomain contacts stabilize mature state
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via energy decomposition analysis

title: Endoplasmic reticulum stress in disease pathogenesis: its implications for therapy
task: Review endoplasmic reticulum stress signaling in disease pathogenesis and therapeutic targeting opportunities
key_results: Three UPR branches (IRE1, ATF6, PERK) regulate stress response and apoptosis; excessive activation drives cancer, cardiovascular, neurodegenerative, metabolic, and autoimmune diseases; ER stress modulation is promising therapeutic approach
comments: Broad integrative review of ER stress mechanisms across diseases, but lacks specific quantitative findings or detailed mechanistic insights for individual pathways.

title: Amitriptyline inhibits EAG1 channels by binding to their PAS domains and exerts EAG1-dependent anti-tumorigenic effects
task: Establish amitriptyline as EAG1 channel inhibitor with EAG1-dependent anti-cancer effects
key_results: Amitriptyline inhibits EAG1 by binding to PAS domains; growth inhibition and migration suppression are EAG1-dependent; effects strongest in high-EAG1-expressing cells (MDA-MB-231, SH-SY5Y); no effect in low-EAG1 A375 cells
comments: Clear target validation through genetic knockin/knockout and structure-activity correlation, though the PAS domain binding mechanism and how it relates to channel inhibition require structural characterization.

model_io.model: MDA-MB-231, SH-SY5Y, A375 cancer cells with EAG1 manipulation; zebrafish xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Amitriptyline binds EAG1 PAS domains and inhibits channel activity
hypotheses.result: Amitriptyline inhibits EAG1-mediated K+ current in patch-clamp recordings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anti-cancer effects of amitriptyline are EAG1-dependent
hypotheses.result: EAG1 knockin increases amitriptyline sensitivity; EAG1 knockout eliminates growth and migration inhibition

title: m1A-mediated regulation of BIRC2 mRNA stability drives apoptosis evasion and tumor progression in liver cancer
task: Elucidate m1A-mediated regulation of BIRC2 mRNA stability in liver cancer apoptosis evasion
key_results: Reduced m1A levels in liver cancer tissues; ALKBH3 demethylase regulates apoptosis via BIRC2; m1A at positions A98/99/100 in BIRC2 5'-UTR enhance YTHDF3/CNOT1-XRN2 interaction and mRNA degradation
comments: Mechanistically detailed m1A-mRNA degradation pathway with clinical validation, though the upstream drivers of reduced ALKBH3 activity in liver cancer remain unclear.

model_io.model: liver cancer cells with ALKBH3 depletion; in vivo and clinical samples

hypotheses.hypothesis: ALKBH3 demethylation of BIRC2 mRNA promotes mRNA degradation and apoptosis
hypotheses.result: ALKBH3 depletion destabilizes BIRC2 mRNA via enhanced m1A-mediated recruitment of YTHDF3/CNOT1-XRN2 complex

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reduced m1A levels protect BIRC2 mRNA from degradation, promoting apoptosis evasion
hypotheses.result: m1A reduction in liver cancer tissue correlates with elevated BIRC2 and apoptosis resistance

title: Regulation of lipid droplets accumulation by the Hippo–YAP/COX2 signaling pathway in neomycin-induced ototoxicity
task: Clarify YAP/COX2 pathway role in neomycin-induced lipid droplet accumulation and hair cell damage
key_results: YAP overexpression reduces abnormal LD accumulation and mitigates hair cell damage; COX2 identified as key YAP downstream target
comments: Connects lipid metabolism to sensory cell survival, though the causal relationship between LD accumulation and HC damage requires clarification.

model_io.model: in vivo and in vitro hair cell damage models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neomycin exposure disrupts lipid metabolism via YAP downregulation
hypotheses.result: Decreased YAP expression correlates with abnormal LD accumulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: YAP regulates COX2 expression to control LD accumulation
hypotheses.result: COX2 identified as key downstream target of YAP in LD homeostasis

title: Tissue-specific mutation of pink-1 jointly induces intestinal dysfunction and contributes to dopaminergic neuron degeneration
task: Establish causal link between pink-1 mutation-induced intestinal dysfunction and dopaminergic neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease
key_results: pink-1 loss delays defecation via dgk-1 suppression; intestinal pink-1 mutation impairs glutathione metabolism and ROS clearance; bacterial accumulation accelerates neurodegeneration
comments: Elegant tissue-specific dissection connecting early GI symptoms to neurodegeneration, though the mechanism linking intestinal dysbiosis to neuronal damage needs further characterization.

model_io.model: C. elegans pink-1 loss-of-function mutant model with mammalian validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neuronal PINK-1 regulates defecation via dgk-1 and CEH-22 transcriptional control
hypotheses.result: pink-1 neuronal mutation delays defecation through suppressed dgk-1 expression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intestinal pink-1 loss impairs ROS clearance and increases pathogenic bacterial colonization
hypotheses.result: pink-1 intestinal mutation suppresses glutathione metabolism, enabling bacterial accumulation and neurodegeneration

title: Extracellular vesicle delivery of Myricetin suppresses ovarian cancer through mitochondrial dynamics by downregulating the ECM1/NF-κB/TGFβ signaling pathway
task: Develop CHO-derived extracellular vesicle delivery system for myricetin to target ECM1/NF-κB/TGFβ pathway in ovarian cancer
key_results: CE+MYR achieves IC50 of 30 µM vs 42 µM for free MYR; reduces ECM1/NF-κB/TGFβ, enhances PTEN/p53/caspases; shifts mitochondrial dynamics toward fusion
comments: Comprehensive phenotypic analysis with relevant endpoints, but mechanistic connection between ECM1 suppression and mitochondrial dynamics remains unclear.

model_io.model: CHO cell-derived extracellular vesicles (CE) loaded with myricetin (MYR)

hypotheses.hypothesis: CE enhances myricetin delivery and efficacy in ovarian cancer cells
hypotheses.result: CE+MYR reduces OVCAR3 viability at lower concentration (30 µM) than free MYR (42 µM)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Myricetin suppresses mitochondrial fission and promotes fusion in tumor cells
hypotheses.result: MYR inhibits DRP1/FIS1 and enhances MFN1/MFN2 expression, shifting toward mitochondrial fusion

title: Temporal expression of CXCR2 ligands in a rat model of LPS—induced pulpitis
task: Characterize temporal expression dynamics of CXCR2 ligands during LPS-induced pulpitis progression
key_results: CXCL1 expression correlates with neutrophil activity and lesion severity; CXCL2 shows delayed, localized expression; pivotal inflammatory shift at 48h
comments: Well-designed temporal study but limited mechanistic insight into differential CXCL1/CXCL2 regulation or functional consequences.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CXCL1 and CXCL2 have distinct temporal and spatial roles in neutrophil recruitment
hypotheses.result: CXCL1 correlates with acute neutrophil activity; CXCL2 shows delayed, localized expression for fine-tuning response

title: Dehydroandrographolide attenuates Toll-like receptor signaling by dual inhibition of MyD88- and TRIF-dependent pathways
task: Determine mechanism of dehydroandrographolide (DAG) anti-inflammatory effects on TLR signaling branches
key_results: DAG inhibits both NF-κB and IRF3 activation; suppresses iNOS, IFNβ, and IP-10 expression via dual inhibition of MyD88- and TRIF-dependent pathways
comments: Demonstrates dual pathway inhibition but lacks identification of the molecular target(s) DAG directly binds or modulates.

model_io.model: RAW264.7 and 293T cells with TLR agonist stimulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: DAG inhibits both MyD88- and TRIF-dependent TLR signaling branches
hypotheses.result: DAG suppresses NF-κB and IRF3 activation regardless of pathway branch

title: SHP2 suppressed the progression of IL-1β induced cartilage damage via modulating BRD4 associated autophagy and pyroptosis signaling pathway
task: Determine SHP2 mechanism in suppressing IL-1β-induced cartilage damage via BRD4/autophagy/pyroptosis axis
key_results: SHP2 decreases BRD4, p-NF-κB, NLRP3, and GSDMD; increases PINK1, LC3-I, and Beclin; reduces mitochondrial damage and apoptosis; restores autophagy
comments: Comprehensive multi-omic analysis with in vivo validation, but the direct interaction between SHP2 and BRD4 and the specific role of pyroptosis vs apoptosis in OA pathology need clarification.

model_io.model: chondrocytes treated with IL-1β and SHP2; OA mouse model

hypotheses.hypothesis: SHP2 suppresses IL-1β-induced cartilage damage by inhibiting BRD4-mediated inflammation
hypotheses.result: SHP2 activation decreases BRD4 and downstream p-NF-κB, IL-1β, and inflammatory cytokines

hypotheses.hypothesis: SHP2-mediated BRD4 inhibition promotes autophagy and suppresses pyroptosis/apoptosis
hypotheses.result: SHP2 increases PINK1/Beclin/LC3-I while decreasing NLRP3/GSDMD/Caspase8

title: Fibroblast-derived matrix human skin equivalents reveal distinct roles for papillary and reticular fibroblasts in human skin barrier integrity and aging
task: Define distinct roles of papillary vs reticular dermal fibroblasts in skin barrier integrity and aging
key_results: Papillary fibroblast-FDMs show improved epidermal differentiation and increased lipid processing enzyme expression; reticular fibroblast-FDMs exhibit decreased lipid lamellae repeat distances, altered ceramide composition, increased TEWL
comments: Excellent tissue engineering model reproducing age-related phenotypes, though causative mechanisms linking fibroblast phenotype to specific lipid processing enzyme changes remain incompletely characterized.

model_io.model: Fibroblast-derived matrix (FDM) skin equivalents with papillary (Pf) or reticular (Rf) fibroblasts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Papillary fibroblasts support superior skin barrier through enhanced lipid processing
hypotheses.result: Pf-FDMs show increased lipid enzyme expression and improved lipid lamellae organization vs Rf-FDMs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reticular fibroblasts recapitulate aging-associated barrier dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Rf-FDMs exhibit decreased LPP distances, altered ceramide profiles, and increased TEWL characteristic of aged skin

title: Galectin-4 contributes to the maintenance of expression and activation of multiple receptor-type kinases involved in peritoneal metastasis
task: Determine role of galectin-4 in maintaining RTK expression and activation for peritoneal metastasis
key_results: Galectin-4 associates with c-MET and EGFR; galectin-4 KO reduces RTK phosphorylation; galectin-4 binds tyrosine-phosphorylated molecules via carbohydrate recognition domain; glycosylation competitively regulates binding
comments: Interesting glycan-dependent protein interaction mechanism, but functional role of galectin-4 in metastasis promotion beyond RTK stabilization remains incompletely defined.

model_io.model: gastric cancer cells with galectin-4 knockout or overexpression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Galectin-4 maintains RTK activation via binding to tyrosine-phosphorylated molecules
hypotheses.result: Galectin-4 KO markedly reduces RTK tyrosine phosphorylation and surface expression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glycosylation competitively regulates galectin-4 binding to tyrosine-phosphorylated proteins
hypotheses.result: B3GALT5 overexpression alters PY protein and galectin-4 localization

title: Mitochondrial translocation of MDM2 and TFAM reprograms metabolism in treatment-refractory cancers
task: Elucidate mitochondrial trafficking mechanism of MDM2 and TFAM regulating OXPHOS in TKI-resistant tumors
key_results: AKT-driven MDM2 cytosolic redistribution and TFAM mitochondrial accumulation enhance mtDNA transcription and OXPHOS; positive correlation observed in 76 patient samples; AKT-MDM2-TFAM disruption reverses resistance
comments: Innovative subcellular biomarker approach and clinical validation, but mechanism of competitive MDM2-TFAM interaction at mtDNA requires deeper mechanistic characterization.

model_io.model: TKI-resistant cell models and patient-derived materials (n=76)

hypotheses.hypothesis: AKT-driven MDM2-TFAM competitive interaction at mtDNA controls OXPHOS in resistant tumors
hypotheses.result: AKT promotes MDM2 cytosolic redistribution with reciprocal TFAM mitochondrial accumulation, enhancing mtDNA transcription

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disrupting AKT-MDM2-TFAM axis reverses metabolic reprogramming and TKI resistance
hypotheses.result: Pharmacologic disruption restores TKI sensitivity in resistant cells

title: Lipid homeostasis plays a critical role in inherited and acquired retinal diseases
task: Review role of lipid homeostasis dysregulation in inherited and acquired retinal diseases
key_results: Dysregulated retinal lipid homeostasis triggers oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and impaired signaling; ectopic lipid deposition contributes to degeneration in multiple eye diseases
comments: Comprehensive review synthesizing lipid metabolism with retinal pathology, but lacks disease-specific mechanistic details and candidate therapeutic targets.

title: p21+TREM2+ senescent macrophages fuel inflammaging and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
task: Identify p21+TREM2+ senescent macrophages as drivers of inflammaging and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
key_results: Senescent macrophages show distinctive p21-TREM2 profile and senescence-associated secretory phenotype; accumulate in aged and MASLD mouse livers and human cirrhotic tissue; senolytic treatment reduces liver inflammation and steatosis
comments: Novel senescent macrophage phenotype with therapeutic validation, though the upstream triggers of macrophage senescence in metabolic disease and the specific macrophage-derived factors driving pathology require further characterization.

model_io.model: primary mouse and human macrophages; aging and MASLD mouse models; human cirrhotic liver tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: Type I interferon signaling via cytosolic mitochondrial DNA drives senescent macrophage secretory phenotype
hypotheses.result: Senescent macrophages exhibit elevated type I interferon signaling and inflammatory mediator secretion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Senescent macrophage elimination reduces chronic liver inflammation and steatosis
hypotheses.result: Senolytic treatment targeting p21+TREM2+ macrophages reduces liver inflammation and steatosis in aged and MASLD mice

title: SpatialCOC: an integrative framework for spatial continuous mapping and cross-omics correction in spatial multi-omics data
task: Integration and spatial correction of multi-omics data
key_results: Identified region-specific continuous spatial domains with improved batch-consistency across trajectory inferences; maintains performance across arbitrary omics dimensions
comments: Uses spatial information as prior to correct biotechnological biases, a sensible approach for heterogeneous multi-omics integration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial information can guide learning of omics-specific patterns and reduce biotechnological bias
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: framework excels at identifying region-specific domains and maintains consistency

title: Postbiotics and paraprobiotics in food biochemistry mechanisms stability and nutritional applications
task: Review of postbiotics and paraprobiotics biochemistry and applications
key_results: Summarizes biochemical composition, mechanisms of action, and applications in human/animal nutrition; highlights omics technologies, AI, and sustainable production innovations
comments: Review article providing synthesis rather than primary research; lacks specific quantitative benchmarks or novel discoveries.

title: AI-enhanced approaches for personalized cardiac treatment: insights from ECG data
task: Machine learning classification of drug-induced ECG changes for personalized cardiac safety
key_results: XGBoost achieved 98.1% classification accuracy; random forest 97.3%; SVM 47.5%; key features: heart rate variability, RR/PR/QT/QRS intervals
comments: High accuracy on ECGDMMLD database is noteworthy, but single-database evaluation limits generalization claims; SVM's poor performance suggests ECG feature space may need nonlinear ensemble methods.

inputs: extracted electrophysiological features (HRV, RR, PR, QT, QRS)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tree-based ensemble methods outperform SVM for classifying drug-induced ECG signatures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: XGBoost 98.1% vs SVM 47.5% accuracy

title: A biosynthetic survey of hypocrealean biocontrol fungi
task: Biosynthetic repertoire survey of hypocrealean biocontrol fungi
key_results: Catalogued 5,221 biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) across 82 fungal species; ~80% encode unknown products; characterized biosynthesis of pyridones, dethiosecoemestrin, efrapeptin, and 4 novel nonribosomal peptide products via synthetic biology
comments: Comprehensive phylogenomic-metabolomic integration reveals vast unexplored chemical space; functional linkage of BGCs to metabolites remains sparse (~20%), highlighting annotation challenges.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypocrealean fungi harbor diverse biosynthetic capacity for biocontrol agents and natural products
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: identified 5,221 BGCs; characterized multiple novel biosynthetic pathways

title: Spatial and single-cell characterization of human glioblastoma tumor microenvironment reveals malignant cellular communities
task: Spatial-transcriptomic characterization of glioblastoma cellular organization and intercellular communication
key_results: Integrated 121 spatial transcriptomics, scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, patch-seq from 100 GBM patients; identified 4 malignant cellular communities with consistent compositions; mapped 2 MES-like subpopulations (MES-Hyp in hypoxia; MES-Ast with vasculature); predicted and verified ligand-receptor pairs; patch-seq revealed neuron-oligodendrocyte progenitor synaptic contacts
comments: Comprehensive multi-omics integration across large patient cohort is methodologically strong; spatial topology maps offer mechanistic insights into TME organization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GBM harbors discrete spatial cellular communities with distinct microenvironmental associations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: identified 4 communities with consistent cross-patient patterns

hypotheses.hypothesis: MES-like tumor cells segregate into hypoxia-associated and vascular-associated subpopulations with distinct ligand-receptor signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: mapped MES-Hyp and MES-Ast subtypes with characteristic cellular neighborhoods

title: Adoption of Standard Reference SNP Identifiers in Agricultural Genomics for Interoperability and Data Reuse
task: Standardization of SNP identifiers for agricultural genomics data interoperability
key_results: Introduced ~220 million reference SNP identifiers (rsIDs) to Gramene and pangenome databases; projected rsIDs to sorghum and maize pangenome varieties
comments: Standards work is foundational but lacks quantitative impact metrics on data reuse or discovery acceleration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adoption of rsID standards improves interoperability and data reuse in agricultural genomics
hypotheses.result: Assumed but not quantitatively demonstrated

title: Decoding the therapeutic promise of Solanum trilobatum in oral submucous fibrosis: a network pharmacology, docking, and bioactivity study
task: Target identification for Solanum trilobatum in oral submucous fibrosis via network pharmacology
key_results: Identified 5 phytochemicals with favorable drug properties; 24 potential OSF targets; 6 hub genes (PLG, ABCB1, PTGS2, HMGCR, NOS2, MAPK3); Solasodine showed binding affinities ≥dexamethasone; leaf extract showed dose-dependent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity at 500 µg/mL
comments: In silico predictions validated by in vitro antioxidant/anti-inflammatory assays, but no in vivo efficacy demonstrated or clinical translation pathway established.

hypotheses.hypothesis: S. trilobatum phytochemicals modulate multiple OSF-associated targets
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Solasodine shows multitarget binding comparable to dexamethasone

hypotheses.hypothesis: S. trilobatum extract exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: dose-dependent activity at 500 µg/mL

title: A leakage-controlled machine learning framework for postprandial triglyceride phenotyping using synthetic clinical data
task: Leakage-controlled machine learning for postprandial triglyceride phenotyping
